banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Keep shallow health green during dependency failure; identify the failing regional business path.
sourceRequiredBehavior: Detect dependency failures that a shallow regional HTTP probe would miss.
sourceAcceptance: Dependency-aware routing/readiness detects the failure; affected journeys and recovery are attributed correctly.
sourceQualification: D-S117 requires partial regional dependency failure while shallow origin probes stay healthy. All health, dependency, region, network, authorization, state, failure and journey fields here are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY, not actual resource, network or fault operations.
preconditions: Open the complete folder directly in a JavaScript-capable browser; no server or framework is required.
Cedar and Maple are invented region labels with fixed shallow HTTP 200, fixture-open network, fixture-authorized access and fixture-synchronized-v7 state for fictional-shopper.
Checkout depends on inventory; catalog depends on a separate available catalog cache.
Use one digit from 1 through 6 for synthetic samples; retain at most eight runs in memory.
actions: Select fixed Cedar inventory-failure DATA and shallow-only checkout; inspect both HTTP 200 samples and the failed Cedar business path.
Compare dependency-aware checkout, which excludes failed or unknown readiness and selects the evidenced alternate.
Rehearse catalog to distinguish the unaffected journey from the failed checkout path.
Inspect missing Cedar inventory evidence; do not invent outcomes, latency or origin recovery.
After observing checkout failure data, select recovered DATA with dependency-aware checkout; compare retained failure and recovery observations.
Use labelled controls by keyboard; recover from errors or explicitly reset the entire in-memory lesson.

syntheticInput.observationPolicy: Every field describing health, dependencies, regions, network, authorization, state, failures and journeys is fixed fictional DATA ONLY.

expectedAssertions: Both shallow HTTP samples remain 200 during the fixed Cedar inventory failure.
Shallow-only checkout fails four of four samples at Cedar -> inventory -> checkout.
Dependency-aware checkout excludes Cedar's failed readiness and completes four of four synthetic samples at Maple.
Catalog remains available in Cedar and is not mislabeled a whole-region failure.
Missing Cedar evidence remains unknown: no synthetic checkout result or latency is fabricated; a working alternate cannot certify origin recovery.
Recovered fixture data requires prior checkout failure data and dependency-aware checkout; prior interrupted samples remain in history.
Typed exact inputs, authentic bounded state replay, immutable traces, and an eight-run limit reject malformed or forged operations without mutation.
Actual browser DOM, keyboard, input/state errors, reset, negative journey, startup asset failures and CSP observations are retained.
limits: No actual resources, dependency failures, regional faults, network changes, authorization, identity, state, journey requests or routing operations.
Synthetic counters and milliseconds are deterministic fixture calculations, not wall-clock measurements, load, SLO or a recovery budget.
History is in memory only and clears on explicit reset or reload.
No packages, framework, scaffold, infrastructure, credentials, deployment or spending.
B-S117 and D-S117 remain incomplete; this rehearsal cannot prove native routing, real recovery, failback or an entire-region outage.
Node 22.23.4 is test tooling, not production Node 24 validation.

Only offline Playwright 1.56.1 and installed Microsoft-signed Edge 156 with the published isolated helper are used. The inactive lifecycle prototype is unqualified; individual checks do not certify unattended lifecycle recovery.

verification.normalVerification: Read-only for lesson and historical observations. Only exact deliberate CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 writes browser evidence.
